overlap_decisions.reason: FlashMorph already jointly optimizes interdependent full/linear layer choices under a budget
Ada-KV, SqueezeAttention, and HeadKV already redistribute cache across heads, layers, and sequence
HeadKV-R2 profiles heads on retrieval-reasoning examples and validates global allocation on contextual and multi-hop QA
arXiv:2603.01426v1 explicitly frames KV compression as routing and separates storage, reachability, and use
GER, head consensus, compressed token-attention graphs, and any-answer-token reachability are already proposed for multi-hop compression failure
Sparse Prefix Caching already gives an exact distribution-aware checkpoint-placement program
Budgeted Attention Allocation already conditions attention-head usage on requested cost
arXiv:2511.00819v1 already combines alternating local/global sparse paths with latent attention
a bundle of KDA, MLA, AttnRes, MoE, HCA, CSA, or cache eviction is not a new mechanism, predictive law, or inseparable systems method

surviving_hypotheses.statement: A preregistered small set of causal information-flow quantities predicts unseen from-scratch recurrent/global layer placements at fixed state and compute better than search, sensitivity, role, and random-placement baselines.
required_baselines: independent layerwise sensitivity and greedy replacement
held_out: one different recurrent or cache representation
surviving_hypotheses.success: prospectively predict held-out rank and absolute failure margins beyond every baseline with stable coefficients and causal interventions

surviving_hypotheses.statement: For examples with independently annotated necessary evidence groups, the probability that every required route and payload group retains at least one causally usable path predicts composition failure beyond any-answer-token erasure, generic reachability, head consensus, answer-span importance, dense mass, output error, and single-source retrieval.
surviving_hypotheses.distinction_to_test: The candidate is the conjunction over separately necessary groups plus prospective incremental prediction and fixed-budget single-source restoration; routing-aware compression, reasoning-aware head profiles, multi-hop fragility, and survival of any answer token are conceded prior art.
required_baselines: captured dense attention mass and attention-output error
surviving_hypotheses.fit_data: discovery examples with required groups labeled independently of selection, diagnostic, and model outputs
held_out: unseen graph structures and hop counts
unseen compression rates and selection budgets
one different compression or sparse-attention family
surviving_hypotheses.success: a frozen nested model adds calibrated held-out prediction beyond every baseline; restoring exactly one missing required group while evicting a matched irrelevant group at fixed physical budget moves both the diagnostic and task outcome as predicted; the result replicates on real multi-document data
falsifiers: GER, token-graph reachability, HeadKV-R2 importance, mass, or output error predicts equally well
the conjunction is almost always zero or one and adds no resolution
required-group labels change after model outputs are inspected
fixed-budget single-group restoration does not recover composition
the effect disappears after controlling for distance, load, answer length, and base difficulty
the relationship fails on real multi-document tasks or a held-out compression family

change_from_v1: adds HeadKV-R2 as a mandatory reasoning-aware head-allocation baseline
adds GER, head consensus, and compressed token-route reachability as mandatory diagnostic baselines
concedes the broad retention-versus-accessibility and multi-hop-route framing
narrows N2 from generic all-source recall to the conjunction over independently necessary groups with incremental prediction and fixed-budget causal restoration
does not change any implementation, training, promotion, or paper-scale authority

code_followup.headkv: declared repository exists but immutable revision, tree, licenses, environment, data, and behavior are unaudited
code_followup.kv_compression_physics: no dedicated code/data artifact is declared on the arXiv record; named KVPress and Expected Attention dependencies are unpinned

full_landscape_before_claim: audit immutable code/data/rights and behavior boundaries for HeadKV-R2 and the routing paper
follow backward references and forward citations for both surviving hypotheses
search arXiv, proceedings, patents, technical reports, deployed systems, and non-English literature with recorded queries and dates
construct a closest-overlap table at claim granularity
evidence_before_claim: freeze labels, hypotheses, models, predictors, and analysis before held-out outputs
use at least three scales with paired uncertainty
hold out architecture, task, rate/budget, and document/domain cells
perform equal-budget causal intervention rather than correlation alone
compare with the strongest reproducible direct method and diagnostics
claim_gate.decision: Paper 1 may claim novelty only if a surviving narrow hypothesis clears both landscape and prospectively held-out causal gates; otherwise it is a replication/systems study or is not positioned as a novel architecture paper.

decision.next_action: audit HeadKV code identity/rights and the routing paper artifact boundary, then continue backward/forward citation review before freezing any N2 empirical protocol
